title: Fuselage — Bilge Aft of Frame 62 — Frame Foot Renewal and Inhibitor Treatment, VANTOR
abstract: Renewal of corroded frame feet between frame 62 and the rear pressure bulkhead on four-engine aircraft, with a full bilge wash, dry and inhibitor treatment, and an extended corrosion inspection interval afterwards.

sections.planning_reason: Fifteen of nineteen four-engine aircraft surveyed above 55 000 flight hours showed exfoliation at the frame feet between frame 62 and the rear pressure bulkhead, and three were beyond the allowable material loss. The condition follows the aft galley and crew rest arrangement that only the four-engine aircraft carry. Operators are finding this at heavy check, unplanned, and the resulting repairs are extending checks by up to fourteen days. Doing the renewal as a planned task inside a check that is already scheduled is substantially cheaper than discovering it.
sections.description: Corroded frame feet are cut back to sound material and spliced with the renewal set. Silicone edging grommets are fitted at every systems penetration through the frame web. The whole bilge between the two stations is then washed, dried and treated with a water-displacing corrosion inhibiting compound.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Get access from inside the aft cabin with the floor panels lifted in zones 143 and 146, and from the aft belly fairing in zones 193 and 385. CAUTION: DO NOT USE A WIRE BRUSH ON THE FRAME FOOT RADIUS. Do AMM-S-53-31-11-100-002-A to wash and dry the bilge and to remove loose corrosion product. Measure the remaining material at each frame foot and record it against the limits in the accomplishment instructions. Cut back each foot that is beyond limits to the nearest sound station. Install the inboard frame skin panel sub-assembly KES742334-41 and the inboard spar cap kit UMB86029-53 as the splice, wet with sealant. Fasten the splice with tension head bolts EN567460-96, anchor nuts EN581282-4E and solid rivets AGS120161-72. Fit silicone edging grommets AES747279-72 at each systems penetration and re-grommet the harness runs with LN701477-19. Dry the bilge again and apply the water-displacing inhibitor over the full area to the coverage rate given in the instructions. Check that every drain path is clear by flowing water through it. Install the floor panels and close the belly fairing. Record the embodiment and the new inspection interval.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to VTR-64C3 and VTR-68R2 aircraft that have not had the frame foot renewal. There is no production cut-in because both four-engine lines are closed, so every aircraft in the fleet is pre-modification until it is done. The twin-engine aircraft have a different aft cabin arrangement and are not covered by this Service Bulletin.
sections.material_note: Kit K5331-1030-01 contains the splice set, the fastener set and the grommets, and is sized for the worst case of every foot being renewed; unused items may be returned for credit. The inhibitor is supplied separately because of its shelf life. Lead time is twenty-four weeks.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled 12-year check, or within 60 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
